svg.title: Consume authorization and issuance: 8 of 12 substeps landed, 0 in progress, 4 open.
svg.desc: A01 authorizer enrollment, A02 post-plan caller control and A03 encrypted-original format are committed in f6dd3cba33fc64670fa78c5dc1bd225b3bb54ef8. A04 durable ciphertext storage, A05 verified retained export, A06 root-controlled key and storage delivery, A07 cold planner connection and A08 private export service are committed in 0ef6024f5d0cf56e865fa39ee767ac57739055e0. A09 independent receiving-purpose custody is NEXT/open, followed by A10 independent original-proof replay, A11 actual consume-grant issuance and A12 cold consume-grant service. Eight substeps are landed, none are in progress and four remain open. Each numbered segment has a visible name and status below, with full stable IDs and completion criteria in the linked tracker. These twelve substeps are inside token-release row 11, not new project milestones. Token release remains 10/16, activation 19/26 and project 34/46 source-landed. Counts are not additive or effort percentages. Source is unbuilt and unexecuted. Production acceptance remains 0/6 verified.
